description: The IC in the photo is an 8-pin SOIC package. However, the OEM datasheet's 'PACKAGE OPTION ADDENDUM' (Page 30) lists the part number ADC0832CCN (specifically, ADC0832CCN/NOPB) exclusively as a 'PDIP (P) | 8' package. The datasheet does not document any 8-pin SOIC variant for ADC0832-N. The connection diagrams also show 8-pin PDIP (Figure 5) and 14-pin SOIC (Figure 2) for ADC0832-N, but no 8-pin SOIC.

The CV dimension analysis compared the measured aspect ratio of the SOIC package in the image to the 'Expected Aspect Ratio' (1.54) and 'Expected Dimensions' (10.16 × 6.6 mm) which correspond to the PDIP-8 package from the datasheet (Page 37). While the aspect ratio match score was high, the actual physical dimensions and form factor of an SOIC-8 package are significantly different and smaller than a PDIP-8 package. This indicates a fundamental dimensional mismatch due to the incorrect package type for the specified part number.
The manufacturer logo preceding the lot code appears somewhat faded compared to the text markings. While this could be due to age or handling, it is noted.
